title: Pydantic AI Harness's PlaywrightBrowser enforces its egress policy on HTTP requests and page WebSockets, but not on…
description: Pydantic AI Harness's PlaywrightBrowser enforces its egress policy on HTTP requests and page WebSockets but does not enforce it on WebRTC, WebTransport, WebSocketStream, or FedCM requests. This allows a page controlled by an attacker to cause the browser to send traffic to disallowed hosts and ports, potentially leaking information such as STUN request responses. The vulnerability affects applications using PlaywrightBrowser to open attacker-influenced pages. Version 0.74.0 of pydantic-ai-harness mitigates this by removing or disabling these features and launching Chromium with relevant protections enabled.
